tools.name: get_pro
tools.description: Returns a checkout link where the user can buy BuyWise Pro ($2.99/month plus any applicable tax, 3,000 checks a month, renewing monthly until cancelled), with the renewal terms and what happens after paying. It never charges anything: payment happens only if the user completes the checkout page.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_brands, check_product, check_products · Public sink: check_brands, check_product, check_products.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_brands, check_product, check_products · Public sink: check_brands, check_product, check_products

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
